name: Eran
title: Son of Shuthelah and ancestor of the Eranites
summary: Eran was a descendant of Ephraim through his son Shuthelah. He is mentioned in Numbers as the ancestor of the clan of the Eranites, one of the family groups within the tribe of Ephraim that were counted during the census on the plains of Moab.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the census
keyEvents.description: Eran is mentioned as the son of Shuthelah in connection with the second census of the people of Israel on the plains of Moab. His descendants, the Eranites, were recorded as a distinct clan within the tribe of Ephraim.

keyEvents.title: The tribe of Ephraim is counted
keyEvents.description: During the census, the tribe of Ephraim was counted at 32,500 men. The Eranites were one of the clans that made up this tribe.

keyEvents.title: The lineage of Ephraim
keyEvents.description: Eran belonged to the lineage of Ephraim through Shuthelah. Ephraim was the son of Joseph, who was blessed by Jacob with the birthright among the tribes.

keyEvents.title: Preparation for the division of the land
keyEvents.description: The census in which the descendants of Er were registered formed the basis for distributing the promised land among the tribes of Israel. Each tribe's inheritance was determined based on the size of their recorded clans.
